journey.name: wear settings swap survives import
journey.description:
The wearer's own swap of the balance's unit lasts across an import of the phone's settings, as long as the phone's setting stays the same: with fiat first on the phone, a tap puts bitcoin first on the watch, and it is still first after a restart and the import that follows it. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: run settings-import-units.xml first, and change nothing on the phone since. Watch: the wallet of settings-import-units.xml, the app open on the Balance page with "WatchHomeBalanceSymbol" reading "€" and the loading ring stopped.

actions.action: Verify "WatchHomeBalance" reads the balance with eight decimals, such as "0.00050000"
Wait up to 1 minute until `adb logcat -d -s BitkitWear` lists "Imported the phone's settings"
Verify "WatchHomeBalanceSymbol" still reads "₿": the wearer's swap lasts while the phone's setting stays the same
